Name: Kenneth's Golden Crops
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Golden Crops[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Basically vanilla crops, but gold.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod adds 38 golden variants of the crops you already know. Same grow times, same seasons, no extra buffs or weird mechanics. They just look gold and sell for more. If you want a farm that looks rich without breaking the game, this is it.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]38 golden crops - Amaranth, Ancient Fruit, Artichoke, Green Bean, Beet, Blueberry, Bok Choy, Cauliflower, Coffee Bean, Corn, Cranberry, Eggplant, Fairy Rose, Garlic, Grape, Hops, Kale, Melon, Parsnip, Pineapple, Poppy, Potato, Pumpkin, Radish, Red Cabbage, Rhubarb, Summer Spangle, Starfruit, Strawberry, Sunflower, Taro, Tomato, Tulip, Wheat, Yam, Rare Seed, Sweet Gem Berry.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]They all have golden sprites, and the ones that can go giant will go giant in gold too.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Plus 4 artisan goods - Golden Beer, Golden Coffee, Golden Pale Ale, Golden Oil. You can make them with Keg / Coffee Maker / Oil Maker, or just buy them if you have the shops.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]I made this specifically for my shop mods, so you need them.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Seed Shop (Shop4 by default) - all 38 seeds are here.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Drink Shop (Shop4 by default) - the 4 artisan drinks are here.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Grocery Store (Shop5 by default) - the 4 artisan drinks are also here for convenience.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All three are configurable. If you use GMCM you can move them to Shop1 to Shop5, whatever setup you prefer.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Editions:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]It's the same mod, just different value. Pick one.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Sprout Edition (2x value) - close to vanilla, just a bit more profit. For balanced farms.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Bountiful Edition (4x value) - comfortable. Good money without feeling cheaty.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Prosperous Edition (6x value) - wealthy. For when you want your golden farm to actually feel rich.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Opulent Edition (8x value) - very wealthy. High-profit, still grounded.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Fortune Edition (10x value) - if you just want to feel rich. Full luxury.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Just install one edition, not all.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]SMAPI, Content Patcher, Kenneth's Seed Shop, Kenneth's Drink Shop, Kenneth's Grocery Store. GMCM is optional but recommended so you can change shop locations.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Install:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install the requirements[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Pick one edition only - Sprout / Bountiful / Prosperous / Opulent / Fortune[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Drop it in Mods[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Done.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]No new save needed. Works fine with existing farms.[/b][/size]
